name: Real-time-middleware
description: C++17 reimplementation of the MCFlow middleware for dependent task graphs on multi-core platforms, extended with configurable bin-packing core allocation (First Fit, Best Fit, Worst Fit, with period and utilization sort criteria) and a measurement harness that reports per-job scheduling latency, jitter and deadline misses under SCHED_FIFO on Linux PREEMPT_RT.
runtimePlatform: Linux with PREEMPT_RT, tested on Raspberry Pi 5 (Cortex-A76)

affiliation.name: ENAC - Ecole Nationale de l'Aviation Civile, Toulouse, France

referencePublication.name: MCFlow: a Real-time Multi-core Aware Middleware for Dependent Task Graphs
referencePublication.author: Huang-Ming Huang, Christopher Gill, Chenyang Lu

publisher.name: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Embedded and Real-Time Computing Systems and Applications (RTCSA)

softwareRequirements: Python 3 with pandas and matplotlib (plotting scripts only)
